# 🧪 NeuralOps v1.3.5: Distillation & Algorithmic Maturation

## 🌟 Highlights
- **Multi-Pillar Knowledge Distillation**: Logit KL divergence, Feature Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), and Attention Map alignment.
- **Advanced Schedulers**: Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) and Cosine Annealing with warmup.
- **SVD-LLM & Tensor-Train**: Integration of multi-linear tensor-train factorization engines.

## 📦 Installation
```bash
pip install neuralops==1.3.5
```
